name: Photometric Stereo Gaussian Splatting Initialization
aliases: Stéréophotométrie par Gaussian Splatting et rendu inverse
definition: A calibrated photometric stereo method that reconstructs 3D surface normals and albedo by optimizing a 3D Gaussian Splatting representation of the scene using inverse rendering, specifically designed for single-view scenarios where traditional Structure-from-Motion initialization is not possible.
